title: Uyirullavarai Kaadal-Hello Guru Prema Ko
desc: Anu and Sanju develop a strong connection while living together in Hyderabad. They realize their love for each other when Anu's arranged marriage is arranged with someone else.

title: Raame Aandalum Raavan Aanadlum
desc: An impoverished rural couple look for their prized bulls, which have gone missing. However, they receive little help from a community that is apathetic to their plight.

title: Ethir Neechal
desc: Janani faces her ambitions crumbling as she enters a patriarchal family through marriage. Her determination drives her to inspire the oppressed women within the family to join her.

title: Majili
desc: After being abandoned by his lover, Anshu, Poorna takes to alcohol and is forced to marry his neighbour, Sravani. However, he soon discovers her unrequited love for him and falls for her.

title: Vikrant Rona
desc: Vikrant investigates a murder and series of deaths lead him to discover something.

title: Dhoni
desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Raid
desc: After receiving an anonymous tip, Amay Patnaik, a senior income tax officer, begins an investigation on an influential man in Lucknow for money laundering.

title: Meegamann
desc: Chitti works for Jothi, a powerful drug lord, and is busy expanding his business and criminal activities. Unfortunately, his trusted assistant, Shiva, has other plans for him.

title: Naan Local
desc: A young man named Babu falls in love and must compete with another suitor to win the approval of the woman's father.

title: Eeram
desc: Vasu finds the dead body of Ramya in an apartment and decides to find her murderer. During the investigation, Vasu encounters more killings and learns that Ramya's spirit is behind their death.

title: O2
desc: Amongst the bus passengers trapped in a landslide and fighting for survival, a single mother goes to great lengths to protect her son by securing an oxygen cylinder.

title: Santharppavaathi
desc: Gautham, a security guard, discovers his grandfather's diary, embarking on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, terrorist Sultan seeks treasure with a kidnapped Pakistani archaeologist.

title: Mundasupatti
desc: Photographer Gopi faces trouble in a village where cameras are seen as dangerous. He becomes involved with the village headman's daughter.

title: Yaaro Ival
desc: Kalyan, a visually impaired chef, vows to aid his love interest Vennela with her financial woes. Heartbroken, he seeks answers when she inexplicably disappears.

title: Boomika
desc: A group surveys a secluded property for renovations, but is terrified by a sinister message from a communicating spirit.

title: Selvi
desc: Cop Krishna aids Sailaja to nab her fugitive father but falls in love with her.

title: Tanga Manithan
desc: Balu, orphaned by his parents' untimely death, grows up without familial love. He embarks on a noble quest to ensure others like him receive the affection they lacked.

title: Seedan
desc: Mano is in love with Maha, a maid, in his grandmother's house, but lacks the courage to confess to his mother. After his marriage is fixed, a distraught Maha vents her anger in Lord Murugan's temple.

title: Ragasiya Kolaiyaali
desc: Anwar, a criminologist, teams up with the Kerala Police to solve a series of rapid serial killings. Time is ticking as he hunts for the killer!
